analysis_method: PhpToken::tokenize(TOKEN_PARSE), comments excluded from runtime edges

definitions.runtime: Executable import resolution, static call, class-constant reference, class-string reference, new expression, inheritance, or trait use.
definitions.loader: Executable dependency on Loader_Map or the plugin autoload registration.
definitions.compatibility: class_exists/method_exists/interface_exists/trait_exists probing or a call to a thin delegating facade method.
definitions.documentation: Class names found only in comments/docblocks; recorded but never emitted as graph edges.
definitions.large_method: Named method spanning at least 80 source lines.
definitions.duplicate_candidate: Methods with at least 12 normalized tokens and the same exact token shape across nodes; semantic review is still required.
definitions.wordpress_dependencies: Explicit WordPress API names plus the wp_/_wp_ prefixes; built-in PHP names are excluded from this signal.
definitions.reference_line_evidence: Node reference maps retain the first source line per name; edge evidence_count retains all occurrence lines, and the raw analyzer retains the complete line map.
